name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began with a fascination for engineering, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, and quickly found his way into the world of racing. Before joining Williams Racing, Ricardo spent several years with smaller teams, honing his skills in logistics, resource management, and trackside operations. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every detail to optimize performance and efficiency. His calm demeanor and sharp problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset in the high-pressure environment of Formula 1.

At Williams, Ricardo is responsible for overseeing all operational aspects of the team, from coordinating race day logistics to managing the supply chain of car components. His dedication to efficiency and his ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise have earned him the respect of his colleagues. He is a firm believer in empowering his team and fostering a collaborative work environment, always encouraging open communication and innovative thinking. Ricardo's ambition is to contribute to Williams' resurgence as a top-tier team, leveraging his operational expertise to drive success on and off the track.
